## BHUTAN — profile (page 131)

- **Header facts:** Region: South Asia; Income group: Lower-middle-income; Lending category: IDA; Data status: Data as reported (A); Population: 797 thousand; GNI: 3,384; Unit: US$ million, unless otherwise indicated.
- **Total external debt stock, 2025:** 3,362, **-1.2% from 2024**.

- **Figure 1. Total external debt, 2015–25:**  
  Printed start/end values are **2,111** (2015) and **3,362** (2025). The line rises from 2015 through the late 2010s, with a small dip around ≈2018, then climbs to a higher level around ≈2020–21, eases slightly around ≈2022, rises again to a **peak around ≈2024** (slightly above 2025), and edges down marginally in 2025.

- **Figure 2. External debt by creditor and creditor type in 2025, including IMF credit and SDR allocations:**
  - **Total external debt:** 3,362
    - **Public & publicly guaranteed:** 3,320
    - **Private nonguaranteed:** 38
    - **Short-term:** 4
  - **Public & publicly guaranteed — by creditor type:** 3,320
    - **Multilateral:** 1,074
      - Asian Dev. Bank: 557
      - World Bank-IDA: 432
      - Other multilateral: 85
    - **Bilateral:** 2,246
      - India: 2,157
      - Japan: 88
      - Other bilateral: 2

- **Figure 3. Debt ratios, 2015–25:**
  - **External debt / exports:** 301%, **-13.6%**. Trend: rises into the late 2010s/around ≈2020, then generally declines toward 2025.
  - **External debt / GNI:** 99%, **-7.9%**. Trend: broadly flat early on, peaks around ≈2020, then trends downward to 2025.
  - **Debt service / exports:** 19%, **+3.8%**. Trend: declines through the late 2010s to a low around ≈2020, then rebounds and ends slightly higher by 2025.
  - **Debt service / GNI:** 6%, **+10.8%**. Trend: falls from 2015 to around ≈2019–20, then rises overall through 2025.

- **Figure 4. Average terms on new commitments from official and private creditors, 2025:**
  - **Official creditors:** Maturity **33 yrs**; Grace period **9 yrs**; Interest rate **1.5%**
  - **Private creditors:** Maturity **..**; Grace period **..**; Interest rate **..**

- **Notes/Source:**  
  **Source:** World Bank Group International Debt Statistics database.  
  **Note:** Figure 4 shows no data values for private creditors because the country did not have new commitments in 2025.
